ColdEyesWatch000.description: Heroic/Hunter. Fires when the creature that dropped is YOUR quarry (whenOnMyList — the own-ledger gate, built 2bZ with this talent). PackHuntQuarry00.description: Hunter. Reaction, 1 focus: add your Survival ranks to a targeted ally's attack OR damage roll against your quarry. 07-24x: replaced a name-gated useItem branch (iron rule 2b) and FIXED both of its live card-vs-engine drifts per Ben's q15 ruling. (a) `requireQuarry` adds the quarry gate the engine never had — the bonus used to land on the ally's next roll of any kind against anything; it is also vetoed BEFORE cost when you have no quarry, so the focus is not burned. (b) `appliesTo: either` makes the damage half real: the next-test pipeline was registered on d20 rolls only, so the card had been promising something impossible. The quarry is resolved when you spend the focus, not at roll time, so re-marking later cannot silently retarget a live bonus.

SeekQuarryPlace0.description: heroic/Hunter. 2bX — the quarry as an H3 ledger (was a bare quarryUuid string flag with a name-keyed use hook): cap 1 (a new quarry replaces the old, the oldest fizzles and unmarks), NOT scene-scoped (the quarry follows the creature), marker status `quarry` on the token. 'Target the creature first' refuses BEFORE cost (the generic H3 prompt veto). The attack-advantage injector and Cold Eyes read the ledger through the edhaQuarryOf adapter — the string→array shape change is why the covenants-style accessor repoint did NOT transfer (the 07-24v correction). Find/study advantage stays the table's call, as the old card said.

handler.note: Advantage on tests to find, attack, and study your quarry — attacks are auto-advantaged; find/study rolls are the table's call.

TaggingArm000000.description: heroic/Hunter. 2bX — the arm (the withernext/predprimed shape): using Tagging Shot marks YOU `tagged` until the end of your next turn; the Move-5-ft-and-attack is the player's, as printed. The old engine branch was UNREACHABLE DEAD CODE (it keyed on Tagging Shot itself dealing damage, and its damage formula is null — it never fired once, and was never benched).

TaggingHit000000.description: heroic/Hunter. 2bX — the armed hit (config; the applyDamage pre-pass reads it): while `tagged`, your next RANGED WEAPON hit consumes the arm and the victim joins your `quarry` ledger (placeList — written post-apply, cap 1, oldest fizzles; +0 bonus damage, the placement IS the payload). A definitively melee hit stands down WITHOUT consuming (rangedOnly, the meleeOnly mirror); a graze that deals damage fires — the card says 'on a hit or a graze'; ⚑ a 0-damage graze cannot reach the damage pipeline and stays owner-judged.
